title: Add Y-axis controls, sensor checkboxes, and download button to TSIC Loggers page

requirements.text: Add Y-axis limit input controls (minimum and maximum) to the TSIC Loggers page that allow users to set custom lower and upper bounds for the graph's Y-axis. These controls should reset to automatic scaling on each page refresh.

quotes: ok, kun je ervoor zorgen dat ik ook de y axis kan kiezen bij de tsic sensoren? dus onderste limiet en bovenste limiet?
ze mogen resetten naar automatische schaling bij elke refresh

acceptanceCriteria: Two input fields are visible on the TSIC Loggers page for setting Y-axis minimum and maximum values
When values are entered, the graph's Y-axis updates to reflect the custom bounds
On page refresh, the controls reset and the graph returns to automatic Y-axis scaling
The controls are positioned near the graph in a user-friendly location

requirements.text: Add checkboxes in the graph legend on the TSIC Loggers page that allow users to toggle individual sensors (S1-S72) on and off. All sensors should be enabled by default on each page refresh.

quotes: Kun je ook zorgen dat er een checkbox staat in de legende zodat ik bepaalde sensoren kan uitzetten?
ze mogen resetten na elke refresh

acceptanceCriteria: Each sensor in the legend displays a checkbox next to its label
Clicking a checkbox toggles the visibility of that sensor's line on the graph
All sensors are checked and visible by default when the page loads
The checkbox state resets to all-checked on page refresh
The legend remains readable and organized with the added checkboxes

requirements.text: Add a download button to the TSIC Loggers page that links to the Google Spreadsheet at https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/11mSpPpRIZikPpacvWtXk-YIQD7ktIg4PHHtN_hIbKE8/edit?usp=sharing. Style the button to match the download button on the Conceptmachine page.

quotes: er moet in de pagina tsic loggers ook een download knop zijn, die moet verwijzen naar deze link: https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/11mSpPpRIZikPpacvWtXk-YIQD7ktIg4PHHtN_hIbKE8/edit?usp=sharing
in de conceptmachine pagina is er ook een downloadknop. Kun je hetzelfde doen, maar dan voor tsic loggers?

acceptanceCriteria: A download button appears on the TSIC Loggers page
The button links to the specified Google Spreadsheet URL
The button styling matches the download button on the Conceptmachine page
Clicking the button opens the Google Spreadsheet in a new tab

constraints: Do not modify the backend; all changes are frontend-only
Do not edit immutable files: frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.ts, frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts, frontend/src/main.tsx, frontend/src/components/ui/*
Maintain the existing TSICSensorChart component structure and data flow
Y-axis controls and checkbox states must not persist across page refreshes
nonGoals: Persisting Y-axis bounds or sensor selections in backend or local storage
Adding Y-axis controls or checkboxes to other pages
Modifying the data fetching logic or backend endpoints
Changing the admin access controls for the download button
